description: Skill-frontmatter UserPromptSubmit hook: warn as content when a named skill is not installed.

foundIn.description: The SKILL.md whose frontmatter name matched, under ~/.claude/skills, the project's .claude/skills, a marketplace or an installed plugin version.

content.description: Empty when installed, else the one [BDK] line.

examples.content: [BDK] skill caveman-commit is not installed; the skill that needs it falls back to its own behaviour.
